feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra assists a gauge-invariant lattice chiral-fermion measure construction
entry.summary: Nathaniel Craig proposes a smooth, exponentially local, gauge-invariant fermion measure on admissible four-dimensional lattices, with restrictions covering the Standard Model gauge groups. GPT-6 Astra helped develop the refinement construction and led the detailed proof. The supplementary report… (Discovery - University of California, Santa Barbara; OpenAI; announced 2026-10-06)

entry.title: ERTransformer-generated TCR candidates activate T cells in defined receptor contexts
entry.summary: ERTransformer generated epitope-conditioned TCR β-chain CDR3 candidates. Flow-cytometry experiments found selected artificial TCRs induced activation comparable to or greater than natural controls in defined TCR/pMHC contexts. This represents the September 2026 journal report; an ERTransformer… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; City University of Hong Kong; The University of Hong Kong; Xijing Hospital of Digestive Diseases; Harvard Medical School, Harvard University; Monash University; announced 2026-09-02)

entry.title: Spatial-DC maps a candidate fibroblast–cancer signaling interaction in pancreatic tumors
entry.summary: Spatial-DC reconstructed cell-type-resolved spatial proteomes and suggested COL8A1–ITGA2 communication between cancer-associated fibroblasts and pancreatic cancer cells. Multiplexed immunohistochemistry supported the spatial predictions; human protein co-expression was associated with survival.… (Discovery - Southern University of Science and Technology; Tencent AI for Life Sciences Laboratory; announced 2026-05-27)

entry.title: ORI engineers active lysozymes, heat-tolerant chitinases and dual-activity enzymes
entry.summary: Tencent researchers used ontology-conditioned generation and experimental feedback to engineer enzymes. In the reported assays, lysozyme TX-RL15 exceeded the earlier TX-L6 design by 66-fold and hen egg-white lysozyme by over two orders of magnitude. Chitinase TX-SC2 retained activity after… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2026-03-19)

entry.title: tFold designs binding antibodies against four defined antigens
entry.summary: Tencent researchers generated antibodies against influenza hemagglutinin, PD-1, PD-L1 and SARS-CoV-2 RBD, followed by phage-display screening and SPR characterization. Anti-SC2RBD-H330 showed neutralization IC50 of 0.42 nM. Screening remained extensive, and some confident epitope predictions… (Discovery - Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2025-12-10)

entry.title: HuDiff humanizes antibodies and nanobodies while retaining measured binding
entry.summary: HuDiff generated humanized variants of a murine SARS-CoV-2 RBD antibody and two alpaca nanobodies. Bio-layer interferometry measured 0.15 nM affinity for the best humanized antibody versus 0.12 nM for its parent; a humanized nanobody measured 2.52 nM versus 5.47 nM. The journal abstract also… (Discovery - School of Basic Medical Sciences, Lanzhou University; Tencent AI Lab; Fudan University; Peking University; announced 2025-10-01)

entry.title: AI-assisted macaque claustrum atlas links cell types with projection zones
entry.summary: Learned segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped connect macaque claustral cell-type distributions with four projection zones identified through tracer experiments. Different glutamatergic compositions preferentially connected to different brain regions. This is the April 3, 2025 journal… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; Stem Cell and Brain Research Institute, Inserm; BGI-Research; Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; announced 2025-04-03)

entry.title: AI-assisted cerebellar atlases reveal primate-specific cellular organization
entry.summary: Deep-learning segmentation and spatial annotation supported cerebellar atlases of macaques, marmosets and mice, revealing primate-specific cell subtypes and regional gene-expression differences. Transcriptomic gradients corresponded with awake functional-connectivity patterns. This represents the… (Discovery - BGI-Research; Chinese Academy of Sciences; Erasmus MC; Tencent AI Lab; announced 2024-09-27)

entry.title: AI-assisted hippocampal atlas maps Alzheimer-associated cellular changes around amyloid plaques
entry.summary: In a six-donor postmortem hippocampal study, neural cell segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped map Alzheimer-associated cell distributions and gene-expression changes. Immunofluorescence supported the inferred accumulation patterns of microglia and astrocytes around amyloid-beta plaques.… (Discovery - Zhejiang University; BGI Research; Tencent AI Lab; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2023-12-07)

entry.title: AI-assisted macaque cortex atlas reveals regional cell-type organization
entry.summary: AI-assisted segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped map 264 transcriptome-defined cell types across the macaque cortex. Regional cell-type composition tracked cortical hierarchy, and cross-species comparisons identified primate-specific types enriched in layer 4. This is the July 12, 2023… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; BGI-Research; Tencent AI Lab; announced 2023-07-12)

entry.title: WenHai-E2E: end-to-end machine learning for global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts
entry.summary: The November 13, 2026 paper introduces WenHai-E2E, which generates global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts directly from observations and reports better forecast accuracy than a numerical system. The abstract and publication metadata reviewed here identify no separate oceanographic discovery or… (Discovery - Laoshan Laboratory; Ocean University of China; Shandong University; Qingdao Guoshi Technology Group; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Foundation model and generative AI yield 3CL protease inhibitors confirmed at sub-micromolar IC50
entry.summary: An AI-assisted 3CL-protease inhibitor study selected 249 molecules from about five million generated candidates and evaluated 18 using free-energy perturbation. Five molecules were experimentally tested; all five inhibited the target below 1 micromolar IC50, and one inhibited more strongly than… (Discovery - IBM Research; Cleveland Clinic; Cleveland Clinic Lerner College of Medicine of Case Western Reserve University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Machine-learned potentials resolve a disorder trade-off in lithium cathode transport
entry.summary: Using actively fine-tuned machine-learning interatomic potentials with experimental validation, the authors report that cation disorder improves lithium-path connectivity but broadens site energies, suppressing diffusion in disordered-rocksalt cathodes. They develop an energy-adjusted percolation… (Discovery - Tsinghua University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Binzhou Institute of Technology; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Human-in-the-loop AI copilot improves topology-optimized structure design
entry.summary: MIT’s November 13, 2026 announcement describes a machine-learning copilot that flags regions for human edits during topology optimization. It reports improved manufacturability and buckling-load performance, but the reviewed announcement identifies no separate structural discovery or… (Discovery - MIT; Georgia Institute of Technology; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Antibody design across observed and forecasted antigenic evolution
entry.summary: The Germinal Multi preprint abstract reports antibodies designed against several antigen variants at once. Experimental screens of tens of designs per campaign found binders to resistance-associated EGFR variants and neutralizers of historical SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from… (Discovery - Stanford University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: AI-enhanced electrocardiography for detection and prediction of dilated cardiomyopathy
entry.summary: In the journal abstract, an AI-ECG model trained on more than 330,000 ECG–echocardiogram pairs detected the dilated-cardiomyopathy phenotype (AUROC 0.87–0.97) and predicted later disease (C-index 0.80–0.87). In familial cohorts, five-year negative predictive values were 95.5% in Antwerp and 91.5%… (Discovery - Imperial College London; University of Antwerp and Antwerp University Hospital; Maastricht University Medical Center; Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; Zhongshan Hospital of Fudan University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra constructs mutually orthogonal Latin squares that improve lower bounds at 33 orders
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra produced explicit mutually orthogonal Latin-square constructions that improve known lower bounds for N(n) at 33 values of n from 22 through 494. The standout construction gives four MOLS of order 22, completing the last open case needed to show N(n)≥4 for every n>10. The same paper… (Discovery - Christopher D. Rosin (Constructive Codes; independent research project); announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: t-SNE-selected LMC radio source receives a spectroscopic AGN classification at z = 2.80
entry.summary: SALT spectroscopy of the previously unclassified source LMC tSNE b8 (R.A. 06:22:41.86, Dec. −68:59:21.9) identified it as an active galactic nucleus at redshift z = 2.80. The source was selected from the blazar-like sequence in a t-SNE map combining VISTA near-infrared and ASKAP radio survey data… (Discovery - Keele University; Southern African Large Telescope collaboration; collaborators; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: GenDIReCT recovers the M87* ring from archival telescope data
entry.summary: GenDIReCT used diffusion-based reconstruction conditioned on calibration-independent closure invariants to analyze EHT observations from 2017, 2018 and 2021. The authors recover ring morphology and estimate a diameter of 42.2 ± 1.5 microarcseconds; geometric modeling gives 42.3 ± 1.1. This is a… (Discovery - CSIRO; The University of Western Australia; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Wearable-based health age models for cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk profiling and coaching
entry.summary: Google Research reported a wearable-based health-age model associated with subsequent hypertension, cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes in the All of Us cohort (22,748 participants). A companion world model simulated 12-week trajectories. In 490 blinded paired reviews, coaches preferred… (Discovery - Google Research; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Machine learning reveals incomplete concordance between DNASE1L3 genotype and cfDNA phenotype
entry.summary: Classifiers and UMAP analyzed 129,676 prenatal-test cfDNA samples, with genotype checks in 169 selected samples. The authors report fragmentomic profiles resembling DNASE1L3 R206C homozygotes in some non-homozygotes, while some confirmed homozygotes initially lacked the profile and acquired it in… (Discovery - Amsterdam UMC; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: Cross-state representation learning enables prospective discovery of dynamic protein allosteric sites
entry.summary: The preprint abstract reports that AllositeUltra recovered allosteric sites among its top three predictions in 65.2% of apo structures and 70.6% of substrate-bound structures. More importantly, application to MAGI2 identified a previously unrecognized interdomain pocket, tested by small-molecule… (Discovery - Shanghai Jiao Tong University; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: Cockpit public-key helper could follow home-directory symlinks during privileged ownership changes
entry.summary: A local authenticated user who can control a target account home directory can exploit Cockpit’s privileged Add Public Key helper. Symlinks in .ssh or authorized_keys paths could redirect privileged ownership/mode operations to other files, allowing local privilege escalation or unauthorized file… (Vulnerability - AISLE in partnership with Red Hat; announced 2026-11-10)
